'''2008 Dagobah Regionals''' was a regional championship and World Championship qualifier played on Saturday 30 August 2008 at Dragon Con in Atlanta, Georgia, with [[Jonathan Murray]] as tournament director.<ref name="pcf-21824-314726">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=314726#314726 Get Your Dragon Con! (Dagobah Regionals, Mini-Open, etc)], Jonathan Murray (Throdo), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (12 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080906210609/http://swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=21824 Internet Archive]</ref> Two further ''Star Wars'' CCG events, a Mini-Open and a cube draft, were held at the convention on Sunday 31 August.<ref name="pcf-21824-314726" />

Dragon Con ran over Labor Day weekend, 29 August – 1 September 2008; a full four-day membership cost $90. [[Jim Colson]], a Players Committee advocate, oversaw all the collectible card game events at the convention.<ref name="pcf-21824-314726" /> Murray had heard from players in Florida, Alabama and Georgia who planned to come.<ref name="pcf-21824-316703">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=316703#316703 Get Your Dragon Con! (Dagobah Regionals, Mini-Open, etc)], Jonathan Murray (Throdo), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (20 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080906210609/http://swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=21824 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Dragon Con, Atlanta, Georgia<ref name="pcf-21824-314726" />
* '''Dates:''' 30 August 2008 (regional); 31 August 2008 (Mini-Open and cube draft)<ref name="pcf-21824-314726" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Jonathan Murray]]<ref name="pcf-21824-314726" />
* '''Entry:''' $5<ref name="pcf-21824-314726" />

== Events ==

=== Dagobah Regionals (30 August) ===

Registration ran from 10 to 11 am, with games starting at 11. The event was six games of Swiss constructed play followed by a two-game final confrontation, at $5 entry. It awarded two Day 2 byes to the [[2008 World Championship]]. The main prize pool was rare and promotional cards donated by [[Kevin Reitzel]], including three oversized cards, foil Japanese Darth Vader cards, [[Theed Palace]] and [[Coruscant (expansion)|Coruscant]] mains, and [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy|Reflections II]] and [[Reflections III]] foils and rares; the same pool served both World Championship qualifiers of the weekend. An optional second pool let each player put in a card or product worth about $10 and take one card out. The organizers did not buy Players Committee prize support.<ref name="pcf-21824-314726" />

=== Mini-Open (31 August) ===

The Mini-Open on Sunday 31 August used the same format, times and $5 entry, with one Day 2 bye to the 2008 World Championship and the same donated prize pool. It was to be run under a three-tournament-director system, or by one director to be named later.<ref name="pcf-21824-314726" />

=== Cube draft (31 August) ===

A four-game cube draft began at 6 pm on Sunday 31 August, at $5 entry, with Murray as tournament director.<ref name="pcf-21824-314726" /> A player posting as Nivuahc, who played with his son, called the cube draft "awesome" and thanked "Jonathon, Kevin, Nick, Graham".<ref name="pcf-21824-332778">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=332778#332778 Get Your Dragon Con! (Dagobah Regionals, Mini-Open, etc)], Nivuahc, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (1 September 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080906210609/http://swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=21824 Internet Archive]</ref>

Ten players took part. Two cubes were used, one belonging to Kevin Reitzel (posting as Draven88) and one to Murray; the players drafted in two pods of five, and each built and played both a Light Side and a Dark Side deck.<ref name="sf-23057-334821">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=334821#p334821 SWCCG DragonCon Cube Booster Draft Report & Pictures!], Draven88 (Kevin Reitzel), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (9 September 2008).</ref> [[Jim Colson]] supplied extra product for prizes and for an unscheduled sealed deck tournament on the Saturday night of the convention, and suggested holding two cube events at the next year's Dragon Con.<ref name="sf-23057-334821" />

A large promotional Yoda shown at the Dragon Con events was a piece Reitzel had kept from his Decipher days.<ref name="sf-23057-334830">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=334830#p334830 SWCCG DragonCon Cube Booster Draft Report & Pictures!], Draven88 (Kevin Reitzel), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (9 September 2008).</ref>

== Results ==

No results were posted in the Players Committee forum topic. A separate report topic gives partial results: [[Travis Cooper]] of Florida finished 2nd, and [[Mark Zoran]] finished 3rd after not having played for years.<ref name="sf-23057-334834">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=334834#p334834 SWCCG DragonCon Cube Booster Draft Report & Pictures!], Throdo (Jonathan Murray), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (9 September 2008).</ref> The Day 2 automatic bids to the [[2008 World Championship]] went to [[Jeremy DiPaolo]] and Travis Cooper.<ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008).</ref> In the Mini-Open on 31 August, [[Graham Bingham]] of Atlanta finished 2nd<ref name="sf-23057-334834" /> and received its Day 2 automatic bid.<ref name="sf-22883-332133" />
